name: ekfrase-plataforma
description: Ekfrase: apps livres para ensinar, aprender e criar (ekfrase.com)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/nucleo --noEmit && tsc -p packages/interface --noEmit && tsc -p packages/arquivo --noEmit && tsc -p packages/maker-core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/maker-doc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/maker-gen --noEmit && tsc -p packages/maker-render --noEmit && tsc -p packages/writer-nucleo --noEmit && tsc -p packages/atualizacoes --noEmit && tsc -p apps/maker --noEmit && tsc -p apps/biblioteca --noEmit && tsc -p apps/vernakula --noEmit && tsc -p apps/writer --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ekfrase/maker && npm run build -w @ekfrase/biblioteca && npm run build -w @ekfrase/vernakula && npm run build -w @ekfrase/writer
scripts.conferir: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
